coordinates.state: Noisy sampler state in standardized x coordinates; not an evaluated clean design.
coordinates.design: Estimated clean endpoint, denormalized to original x units.
coordinates.score_vector: Negative standardized proxy losses; used for angles and scalarized scores.
coordinates.predicted: Proxy losses in original objective units; lower is better.
coordinates.candidate_id: Local neighborhood pool index; not persistent particle identity.
coordinates.undefined_angles: Non-finite upstream acos results are null, never repaired to zero. Recorded masks, safeguard argmin and winners preserve the original run. Fallback means admitted despite failing the raw angle test, including undefined comparisons.
